Dear Margot and Elisa,

I am thrilled to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at Fantail. As a pet lover and a junior digital marketer with a technical edge, I am drawn to your mission of creating premium, sustainable pet products that elevate the lives of pets and their humans. Your focus on quality, design, and sustainability resonates with me, and I am eager to contribute to your ambitious international growth plans.

Currently, I work as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, where I own on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I am also passionate about brand building. I understand that effective performance marketing is rooted in a strong, cohesive brand identity, and I am committed to ensuring every touchpoint reflects Fantail's premium aesthetic.
